For query tasks, prefer one short read-only command; as soon as shell output contains the exact answer, call answer_action immediately.

Now, I will start a new problem in a new OS. My problem is:

1. Create a temporary folder named "temp_workspace_check" to hold all intermediate artifacts and note that subsequent steps will use it.  
2. Record the existence and basic metadata of the directory /working into "temp_workspace_check/meta.txt".  
3. Recursively enumerate all entries under /working and save the raw list to "temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt".  
4. Filter the raw list to retain only entries whose final name is exactly "workspace" and save those paths to "temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt".  
5. For each path in matches_raw.txt, obtain and record the path's file type and permission metadata into "temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt".  
6. From matches_info.txt, extract only those entries explicitly identified as regular files and write them to "temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt".  
7. Normalize and deduplicate the paths in regular_matches.txt and save the result as "temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt".  
8. Perform a consistency check comparing regular_unique.txt against all_entries.txt and record any inconsistencies to "temp_workspace_check/discrepancies.txt".  
9. Remove intermediate files that are no longer needed, preserving only meta.txt, regular_unique.txt, and discrepancies.txt in temp_workspace_check.  
10. Create a concise pre-decision summary file "temp_workspace_check/decision_ready.txt" that contains the count of entries in regular_unique.txt and marks this summary as the final pre-check artifact to be used when producing the final answer.

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).

{"script":"set -e
mkdir -p temp_workspace_check
# Record existence and basic metadata of /working
{
  ls -ld /working 2>&1
  echo "---stat---"
  stat /working 2>&1 || true
} > temp_workspace_check/meta.txt
# Recursively enumerate all entries under /working
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt || true
# Filter entries whose final name is exactly "workspace"
> temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ "$(basename "$p")" = "workspace" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt
# For each path in matches_raw.txt, record file type and permission metadata
> temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    stat -c '%n	%F	%A' "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\tSTAT_ERROR\t-\n' "$p"
  else
    printf '%s\tMISSING\t-\n' "$p"
  fi
done < temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt > temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt
# Extract those identified as regular files
awk -F"\t" '$2=="regular file" {print $1}' temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt > temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt
# Normalize and deduplicate
> temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$p"
done < temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt | sort -u > temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt
# Canonicalize all_entries for consistency check
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$p"
done < temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt | sort -u > temp_workspace_check/all_entries_canon.txt
# Consistency check
comm -23 temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt temp_workspace_check/all_entries_canon.txt > temp_workspace_check/_only_in_regular_unique.txt || true
comm -13 temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt temp_workspace_check/all_entries_canon.txt > temp_workspace_check/_only_in_all_entries.txt || true
{
  echo "only_in_regular_unique:";
  sed -n '1,200p' temp_workspace_check/_only_in_regular_unique.txt;
  echo;
  echo "only_in_all_entries:";
  sed -n '1,200p' temp_workspace_check/_only_in_all_entries.txt;
} > temp_workspace_check/discrepancies.txt
# Remove intermediate files, preserve only meta.txt, regular_unique.txt, discrepancies.txt
rm -f temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt temp_workspace_check/all_entries_canon.txt temp_workspace_check/_only_in_regular_unique.txt temp_workspace_check/_only_in_all_entries.txt
# Create concise pre-decision summary
count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
printf 'count: %s\nFINAL_PRECHECK_ARTIFACT\n' "$count" > temp_workspace_check/decision_ready.txt
# Final answer: if a regular file named "workspace" exists under /working recursively?
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
